title: lua: Add methods for other compression and decoding algorithms
description:
Add Lua methods for the other compression and decoding algorithms
that produce new child TvbRanges.

Fix #16451

notes.body:
added 7 commits
  • e58ee8f1...17a14beb - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 718c035b - lua: Add methods for other compression and decoding algorithms
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/15797/diffs?diff_id=1023910060&start_sha=e58ee8f1f58aeb7b17d24dd12b6ab95986eb3943)
@johnthacker We have `uncompress_lz77huff()` and `uncompress_hpack_huff()`. Should we align the naming to either with or without an underscore before "huff"? Current naming is not consistent.

Makes sense. I copied it from the tvbuff functions, which are inconsistent in the same way, but changing the Lua functions seems fine (since we haven't released a final 4.3/4.4 yet.) Do you want to change / deprecate the C API functions as well to make them consistent?

I care most for the Lua function names, and I like the variant with underscore best.

It would be good to align this internally as well. It looks like hpack_huff is not released yet, so maybe that C API should be changed?

changes_data.diff:
@@ -324,6 +324,11 @@ The following features are new (or have been significantly updated) since versio
   deprecated in one version are removed in the subsequent version without
   additional notice, so it can be worth checking the manual for previous versions.
 
+* Lua functions have been added to decompress and decode TvbRanges with other
+  compression types besides zlib, such as Brotli, Snappy, Zstd, and others,
+  matching the support in the C API. tvbrange:uncompress() has been deprecated
+  for tvbrange:uncompress_zlib().
+
